opportunity.eventDescription: Charged when a SAM.gov opportunity row is pushed. A row is pushed only when this charge fits under maxSpendUsd. skipped, blocked, robots, not_found, spend_capped, and error rows are saved and not billed.

award.eventDescription: Charged when a USAspending contract-award row is pushed. Same $0.008 success-only price as an opportunity. Status rows are not billed.
